name: ChatGPT Atlas browser
summary: A web browser with ChatGPT built in. In agent mode it can click, type and fill in forms on websites for you, using the sites you are logged in to.

howToTurnOff.windows: Open Atlas > Settings and switch off browser memories and agent access to logged-in sites if you do not use them. To remove it, open Settings > Apps > Installed apps, find it, select the three dots and choose Uninstall.
howToTurnOff.mac: Open Atlas > Settings and switch off browser memories and agent access to logged-in sites if you do not use them. To remove it, quit it, then drag it from Applications to the Bin.

name: Comet browser
summary: A web browser with an AI assistant built in. The assistant can read the pages you visit and click, type and fill in forms for you.

howToTurnOff.windows: Open Comet > Settings to limit what the assistant can do. To remove it, open Settings > Apps > Installed apps, find it, select the three dots and choose Uninstall.
howToTurnOff.mac: Open Comet > Settings to limit what the assistant can do. To remove it, quit it, then drag it from Applications to the Bin.

name: Dia browser
summary: A web browser with an AI assistant that can read the tabs you have open to answer questions about them.

howToTurnOff.windows: To remove it, open Settings > Apps > Installed apps, find it, select the three dots and choose Uninstall.
howToTurnOff.mac: Open Dia > Settings to limit what the assistant can read. To remove it, quit it, then drag it from Applications to the Bin.

name: Open Interpreter
summary: A free tool that lets an AI model run programs and commands on your computer, and read or change files, after you approve each step.

howToTurnOff.windows: Close the window it is running in. To remove it, open a command prompt and run: pip uninstall open-interpreter
howToTurnOff.mac: Close the Terminal window it is running in. To remove it, open Terminal and run: pip uninstall open-interpreter

name: Screenpipe
summary: Records your screen and microphone all the time so AI tools can search and use what you have seen and heard. Recordings are kept on your computer.

howToTurnOff.windows: Open Screenpipe and stop recording. To stop it starting with Windows, open Settings > Apps > Startup and switch it off. To remove it, open Settings > Apps > Installed apps, find it, select the three dots and choose Uninstall.
howToTurnOff.mac: Open Screenpipe and stop recording. Then open System Settings > Privacy & Security and remove it from Screen & System Audio Recording and Microphone. To remove it, quit it, then drag it from Applications to the Bin.

name: LM Studio
summary: Runs AI models on your own computer. If tool connections (MCP servers) are added, the AI can use them to open files or run programs.

howToTurnOff.windows: Open LM Studio > Program > Edit mcp.json and remove servers you do not use. To remove it, open Settings > Apps > Installed apps, find it, select the three dots and choose Uninstall.
howToTurnOff.mac: Open LM Studio > Program > Edit mcp.json and remove servers you do not use. To remove it, quit it, then drag it from Applications to the Bin.
